text: As directed by City Council at its meeting of June 26, 27, 28 and 29, 2018, a formal request for data about refugee/asylum claimants in Toronto's shelter system has been submitted to the Government of Canada. City staff will continue to collaboratively work with federal and provincial officials to support a data-informed approach. Any information received from the Government of Canada will be provided to City Council, as possible, as part of future updates on this issue.
City Council on July 23, 24, 25, 26, 27 and 30, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council receive the report (July 20, 2018) from the Interim City Manager for information.
